# DevShelf
> The Zero-Paywall Open-Source Developer Directory & Model Context Protocol (MCP) Catalog

DevShelf is a community-driven, open-source directory indexing 565+ verified developer tools, free APIs, AI coding agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with zero paywalls.

Website: https://ritualdev.in/devshelf/
Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/DevShelf
License: MIT

## Public REST API
- Tools JSON: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/tools.json
- Categories JSON: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/categories.json
- OpenAPI Specification: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/openapi.json

## Quick Start CLI
```bash
# Search catalog directly from terminal
npx devshelf search "postgres"

# List verified free APIs
npx devshelf list --category apis

# Run as local MCP server for Claude Desktop / Cursor
npx devshelf mcp
```
